title: Custom C# Resource not possible to cast in [Export] Property but working in [Export] Godot Dictionary
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducable in 4.6.3 (Custom build incl. GodotSteam) ### System information Godot v4.6.3.godotsteam.mono (35e80b3a8) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900KF (32 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory ### Issue description When using [Export] for a property (custom resource) it does not accept the resource because of the following error message: ``` ERROR: D:/Projekte/The Explorers/Engine/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113 - System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'Godot.Resource' to type 'TheExplorers.Worlds.Environment.Water.WaterLayerConfig'. ERROR: at TheExplorers.Biomes.BiomeConfig.SetGodotClassPropertyValue(godot_string_name& name, godot_variant& value) in D:\Projekte\The Explorers\05 - Tests\BugSerializingDictAndProperty\.godot\mono\temp\obj\Debug\Godot.SourceGenerators\Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptPropertiesGenerator\TheExplorers.Biomes.BiomeConfig_ScriptProperties.generated.cs:line 35 ERROR: at Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Set(IntPtr godotObjectGCHandle, godot_string_name* name, godot_variant* value) in D:\Projekte\The Explorers\Engine\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\Bridge\CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:line 57 ``` But when using a Godot.Collections.Dictionary it is possible to assign it as value. It is also working in code. I am not totally sure but I guess this has to do something with the resource inheriting from abstract and being generic. ### Steps to reproduce in the MRP: 1. Open the custom testbiome resource 2. Assign a new resource to "Landscape Layer" (not working) 3. Open the LandscapeLayers Dictionary and assing new resource to the value (working) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [BugSerializingDictAndProperty (2).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31040654/BugSerializingDictAndProperty.2.zip)
